mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 69 degrees under a full moon near the Verona Public Library. Tonight will cool down to 53 degrees with no rain predicted. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The city has announced a road closure on Highway M near the future Aldi site from Monday to Wednesday for asphalt and utility work, following the completion of earlier phases of the project.
We have a full slate of activities starting with live music today, yoga tomorrow, and several trivia nights and the farmer's market taking place through the week.
In a noteworthy update, on September 5, Verona police officers responded to reports of multiple vehicles targeted by a viral social media prank involving cheese placed on windshields.
Today's flavor is the classic Turtle, and since the shop is open until 10 PM tonight, you have plenty of time to stop by for a frozen treat.
